query:
INSERT INTO users (oidc_sub, email, name, groups, is_admin)
           VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)
           ON CONFLICT(oidc_sub) DO UPDATE SET
               email = excluded.email,
               name = excluded.name,
               groups = excluded.groups,
               is_admin = excluded.is_admin
           RETURNING id as "id!: i64"
